notes: 'away' is the ἀπο- preverb's realization and stays inside the verb's own unit, no preposition standing to answer to it (rules 15, 106); head on the verb word.
τὰ πάντα split into the article's 'them' and the quantifier's bare 'all' (rules 22, 102).
αἰσχρολογίαν heads on 'speaking', the root word, as the corpus heads 'evil speakings' on 'speakings' (rules 66, 91).
